Package io.jengacode.eduvideo.objects

Class TextObject

java.lang.Object
io.jengacode.eduvideo.scene.SceneObject
io.jengacode.eduvideo.objects.TextObject
Direct Known Subclasses:
EquationObject
public class TextObject extends SceneObject
Baseline-aligned Unicode text with character or word reveal.

Stores immutable text with font, alignment and character/word reveal configuration. Character reveal respects Unicode code points; multi-line text advances by 1.3 times the font size.
